title: Kiosk Home Avatars
lede: Staff at the counter scan the home list for a face, not a name. Every person row now leads with that person's avatar, falling back to initials.

sections.heading: Side by side
sections.note: Baseline = origin/main fd1b138f built Debug; after = this branch. Same created iPad Air 11-inch (M4) iOS 26.5 simulator, same GT_KIOSK_SCENARIO fixtures, dark, 1180x820 pt landscape crop. Fixture avatarUrl values are null, so the initials fallback is what renders.

pairs.title: Idle home
pairs.sub: Overdue, due back today, ready for pickup, out due later.
pairs.beforeCap: An 8pt status dot led each row.
pairs.afterCap: A 34pt avatar with a status-colour ring leads each row.

pairs.title: Game day
pairs.sub: Event cards with pickups, checkouts, and crew without gear.
pairs.beforeCap: Crew without gear was a text line only.
pairs.afterCap: Crew without gear gets an avatar stack (up to 3, then +N).

changes.h: Status dot became a ringed avatar
changes.was: 8pt dot coloured by section; person identified only by text.
changes.now: KioskAvatar (30pt inside a 2pt ring, 34pt total) in the dot's colour; initials fallback, 'SC' for shared.

changes.was: Names and call times as a single text line.
changes.now: Overlapping avatars precede the same text line.

verification: xcodebuild WisconsinKiosk Debug build on the created simulator: BUILD SUCCEEDED
npx vitest run tests/: 712 files passed, 1 skipped (5014 tests)
No payload change: the dashboard route already projects requesterAvatarUrl/initials for checkouts, requester.avatarUrl for pickups, and avatarUrl for crewWithoutGear; Swift models already decode them
notes: Photo rendering (non-null avatarUrl) is not shown: fixtures use null URLs to avoid a network dependency. KioskAvatar's AsyncImage path is unchanged and already in use on the Today tiles.
